description: This file defines the VoiceWakeForwarder utility, which includes functions for prefixed transcription with machine name context, error handling via VoiceWakeForwardError, forwarding voice wake commands via network, and checking connection status. It aggregates logging, networking, and error management specific to voice wake forwarding functionality.

classes.name: VoiceWakeForwardError
classes.description: An enum conforming to LocalizedError and Equatable that represents errors during voice wake forwarding, currently only rpcFailed with an associated message.

methods.name: prefixedTranscript
methods.description: Generates a prefixed voice transcript message including machine identification info.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Asynchronously sends the voice transcript to a remote agent, handles success or failure, and logs the operation.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks the network connection status to the voice wake agent.
